svg.title: The context window is a jar you refill every turn
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The context window is a jar you refill every turn” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn measuring jar labelled the context window, filled from the bottom with hachured token bands - system 900, tool schemas 4,200, rolling summary 350, last ten turns 4,500 and retrieved memories 600 - under a dashed red fill line, with a note that at 128k it still fits while recall has already fallen to 96 percent. The system and tool-schema bands are ringed in green as a cacheable prefix taking $1.60 to $0.20. A decision ellipse asks whether the fact will be needed by name later and routes to a pgvector STORE, a lossy SUMMARY or the verbatim WINDOW, while a box reading 'just send everything, context is 1M now' is struck through beside 613,750 tokens costing $3.34 for one fifty-turn chat.
svg.text: The context window is a jar you refill every turn
draw it from memory, then compare
